From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novacare.com>, Maya Thompson <maya.thompson@novacare.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: Aligning calendars for 30-min product brief & SME confirmation

Hi Samir / Maya —

Thanks again for taking the call earlier today. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we don’t lose momentum: 

- Recap: You’re evaluating inference runtime options for data-sensitive workflows (low-latency generation + private deployment). Key constraints: SSO + VPC, token-level cost visibility, and a short pilot on a 2–GPU footprint.
- Goal for next call: 30-minute product brief (high-level demo + 10-minute Q&A) focused on how Redwood handles private deployments, routing/fallback, and cost controls.

Can you please pick one of these 30-minute windows (all times PT):
1) Thu Nov 18 — 10:00–10:30 PT
2) Fri Nov 19 — 14:00–14:30 PT
3) Mon Nov 22 — 09:30–10:00 PT

Also: would like to confirm which Novacare stakeholders will join (technical owner + procurement contact if available). I’ve cc’d Neha (solutions engineering) and Rishi (account lead) — Neha will run the demo.

Attachments: redwood-30min-agenda.pdf (agenda + 10-min prep checklist), mutual-action-plan-novacare.xlsx (starter MAP, editable).

If none of those slots work, send two alternatives and we’ll try to accommodate.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing the conversation.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: redwood-30min-agenda.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: mutual-action-plan-novacare.xlsx (Excel)]
